'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Sean Miller DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean Miller]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Typed sheet. Inventory header IAO; sheet objective is Bring Him Before Me (IAO is an Effect).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sean Miller]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
